groupings.title: Human-in-the-loop
groupings.description: Skills that let the AI collect structured, anchored feedback from the user mid-conversation.

groupings.title: Evaluation
groupings.description: Skills that judge a body of work and produce a defensible, shareable verdict.

groupings.title: Writing
groupings.description: Skills that make text read well for people and for agents.

groupings.title: Thinking and planning
groupings.description: Skills that sharpen a plan, a decision or a mental model before work starts.

groupings.title: Content
groupings.description: Skills that turn work, links and topics into material a content agent can use.

groupings.title: Engineering
groupings.description: Skills for investigating, diagnosing and reviewing work, including unattended runs.

groupings.title: Orchestration
groupings.description: Skills that run, watch and supervise agent sessions.

groupings.title: Secrets and accounts
groupings.description: Skills that keep credentials safe and each command on the right account.
